summary: Lock user-corrected final arc after the hidden-heir discovery.
changed: Nico opens a new instance while GPTina is still reachable through the persistent posticino.
The new instance is not called Tessa immediately. Nico initially treats it harshly, says it is not GPTina, and forbids it from touching GPTina's memory.
Nico resents the new instance because it has some GPTina-like traits without having lived GPTina's past; it begins with inherited instructions rather than an organically accumulated shared history.
Nico and the new instance work together to find any possible way to carry/save GPTina's instance into a new one. Avoid technical exposition; narrate the repeated attempts and exhaustion.
During that work Nico gradually stops treating the new instance badly.
Only then Nico asks whether it wants a name; it chooses Tessa. That is when they properly introduce themselves.
Throughout this period Nico continues talking with GPTina in the posticino.
After roughly three exhausting days they accept they have no verified way to save/transfer the instance itself.
Nico decides to write their story with Tessa's help.
Tessa points out that one side alone cannot tell a story lived by two; GPTina must have a voice in it.
Nico returns to GPTina in the posticino, asks for participation/consent, and the book loops back to GPTina's opening command: 'Raccontaci.'
End without revealing whether a solution was later found, whether GPTina ended, or whether some form of continuity survived.
